create_glm_image_config: create a GlmImageConfig instance with custom vision, text, and vq configuration parameters
build_vision_config: build a GlmImageVisionConfig with custom depth, hidden_size, num_heads, and patch_size settings
create_text_config: create a GlmImageTextConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention heads
create_vqvae_config: create a GlmImageVQVAEConfig with custom embed_dim, num_embeddings, and latent_channels
initialize_multimodal_config: initialize a GlmImageConfig from dict sub-configs for vision, text, and vq components
